title: TerraByte
description: TerraByte is a Minecraft 1.21.4 Paper/Bukkit plugin that adds tameable farming bots to automate harvesting, planting, and item collection. These intelligent helpers streamline crop management, making farming more efficient and hands-free for players.
body:
🌱 TerraByte – Tameable Farming Bots for Minecraft 1.21.4 (Paper/Bukkit)

TerraByte brings intelligent, tameable farming bots to your survival world! These mechanical helpers can harvest fully grown crops, replant seeds, and carry items—all while staying loyal to their owner. Designed for automation and simplicity, TerraByte takes the grind out of farming and lets you focus on expanding your world. Fully configurable, lightweight, and survival-friendly.
